resources.string: Pick who runs each agent. %1$s runs it needs that provider\'s API key. I run it uses the coding tool you already pay for — native harness polling, a Custom Agent, or a webhook server you host.
%1$s runs this agent in the cloud, so it works without a computer running at home.
Your own %1$s setup does the work. Connect it once, assign this agent a task, and mark the task Ready.
Connect, install, schedule and test recipes for every harness live in the guide; the workflow skill is generated to match.
A server you host is pushed this agent\'s work the moment it appears — for machines with a permanent address.
